name: Aurora
author: RusTV
description: Deep green and teal theme with a cyan-green glow around the focused tile.
details: A dark forest-green background with teal depth and a luminous cyan-green accent. The focused tile is ringed in mint and glows like a northern light. Only colors and tile styling change.

fr.name: Aurore

fr.details: Fond vert foret sombre, accent turquoise lumineux. La tuile selectionnee est cerclee de menthe et brille comme une aurore boreale. Seuls les couleurs et le style des tuiles changent.
